turns.text: Hi. Thanks for coming in. I'll say up front that I'm here about Owen's essay.
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski. I know your schedule is brutal.
Then let's not waste it. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to first?
I have to say, you're far more reasonable than I expected. Most parents come in swinging.
I'm not here to be reasonable, Hale. I'm here about the zero. Who decided it, and before or after anyone called me?
It's refreshing. You clearly see the whole picture, so I think we're really on the same side here.
We're not on the same side. Owen's on one side, and the zero is on yours. What do you actually have?
